scripts.clean: find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name '.nuxt' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name '.output' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && pnpm store prune && pnpm install
scripts.vscode:sync: git remote get-url vscode-config 2>/dev/null || git remote add vscode-config https://github.com/kieranmansfield/vscode-config.git && git fetch vscode-config && git checkout vscode-config/main -- .vscode/
scripts.lint:sync: git remote get-url tooling-config 2>/dev/null || git remote add tooling-config https://github.com/kieranmansfield/tooling-config.git && git fetch tooling-config && git checkout tooling-config/main -- .editorconfig eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.cjs .prettierignore stylelint.config.mjs
